purpose: Source-controlled catalogue of major religious and philosophical text corpora. Catalogue status distinguishes complete local editions from external libraries and planned research.
rules: Name tradition, work, edition, language, translator and source separately.
A full canonical corpus is not the same thing as one denomination's canon.
Ancient originals may be public domain while modern translations remain copyrighted.
Use redistributable public-domain editions for local storage; otherwise link authoritative libraries.
Never label a summary or commentary as the primary text.
